_comment: AA-879 coverage ratchet for the Unit Tests job (pytest --cov=services --cov=shared). 'floor' is the hard minimum (percent of lines); it may only go up, never down (checked against the base branch). 'goal' = 'baseline' (the measured total on 'set_on') + 'monthly_step' per whole month since 'set_on', capped at 'cap'; being below the goal only warns. Raise 'floor' in any PR once the measured total is at least floor + 1.
